verdict: A (qualified): the documented procedure reconstructs every retained structural measurement from the publicly deposited coordinates
scope: AFP 6RBN/6RC8 (families F1=Afp2, F2=Afp3) and diffocin 8V3X/8V3Y (F1) - the three proteins the regression uses. Excluded systems not re-run.

agreement.R_i: exact: max |diff| 8.3e-17 across all 224 sites, 0 sites above 1e-6
agreement.gnm: NOT reproduced as written (max |diff| up to 5.3e10, all sites); reproduced to <=1.6e-13 at every site once the Kirchhoff zero mode is excluded explicitly instead of left to numpy pinv's default rcond

gnm_root_cause.mechanism: covariates.monomer_gnm_fluctuation takes the diagonal of np.linalg.pinv(kirchhoff). The Kirchhoff matrix is singular by construction (one rigid-body zero eigenvalue). pinv's default cutoff is rcond = max(M,N)*eps relative to the largest singular value, which sits at the same order as that eigenvalue, so whether it is inverted or zeroed depends on the LAPACK build.
gnm_root_cause.observed_here: numpy 2.5.4 inverts it, adding a near-constant offset of ~1.3e9 (Afp2), ~5.3e10 (Afp3), ~-6.7e7 (diffocin); min, median and max of the reconstructed values agree to 4 significant figures. Pearson correlation with the retained values is still 0.999 because the offset is near-constant.
gnm_root_cause.which_values_are_correct: the RETAINED ones. Excluding the zero mode explicitly (eigh, drop eigenvalues <= 1e-10 of the maximum) reproduces the retained GNM to <=1.6e-13 at every one of the 224 sites.
gnm_root_cause.consequence_for_published_numbers: none - the retained values are validated, not replaced.
gnm_root_cause.fix_for_future_reproduction: covariates_zeromode_fix.py in this directory; the archived producer is left unmodified so its recorded SHA-256 remains valid.
